roadmap.title: Quick offline setup matches
roadmap.description: Use a 1v1 Exhibition with no bots and Max Score 1 to win games in seconds; finish the easy win, scoring, customising and arena achievements.

roadmap.title: Season mode
roadmap.description: Play one 9-week Rookie 1v1 season with four playoff teams for the four season achievements.

roadmap.title: Mode and item achievements offline
roadmap.description: Use private matches for Snow Day, Hoops, Rumble, Dropshot, bots and specific cars.

roadmap.title: Online play and items
roadmap.description: Play online for club, tournament, ranked and drop-based achievements.

roadmap.title: Long grinds
roadmap.description: Finish the distance, boost, shot and item counters, then unlock Virtuoso.

achievements.description: Unlock All Original Achievements
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Rocket League.

steps.text: Earn the other 87 achievements. This one unlocks after the last.

achievements.description: Collect 150 Items
achievements.summary: Collect 150 items.

guide.context: Steam counts 150 items. Trade-ups count toward the total even though they use up items. Players who owned the game before it went free-to-play often start with well over 150 items. Free-to-play players should expect a long grind.

steps.text: Finish games to earn item drops. Short matches are fastest: use an @mechanic{Exhibition} match with 1v1, no bots and Max Score 1 goal. Score once, then press Ready for the next game.
Use the free sources when drops run slow: redeem the code popcorn under Settings > Redeem Code, and open tournament, Rocket Pass and event drops.
Trade up five items of one quality for one better item. Items traded in still count; blueprints do not.

achievements.description: Drive a total of 50 km
achievements.summary: Drive 50 km in total.

guide.context: The distance counter is slow and may lag. Another method is to hold the drive and boost buttons with rubber bands and leave the match running.

steps.text: Start an Exhibition match with no bots, Max Score 1, Boost Amount Unlimited and Boost Strength 10x.
Drive onto a wall and hold boost to run up distance.
Stay on one set of wheels. End and restart the match now and then so the counter updates.

achievements.description: Win a total of 30 games across any game mode
achievements.summary: Win 30 games in any mode.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Score the one goal and let the match end. Repeat until 30 wins are counted.

achievements.description: Win the Season Championship
achievements.summary: Win the Season Championship.

steps.text: Start a season with Play > Play Offline > Season: 1v1, Rookie difficulty, 9 weeks, 4 playoff teams.
Finish the regular season, then win both playoff games.
At kickoff, grab the boost pads on the way and hit the ball over the bot toward the goal. Restart any match you are losing; the season saves only when a game ends.

achievements.description: Win 10 games in a row across any mode
achievements.summary: Win 10 games in a row in any mode.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Win ten matches without a loss. Alone with no bots, each match is one goal.

achievements.description: Score 6 Goals in a single game
achievements.summary: Score 6 goals within one match.

steps.text: Start an Exhibition match alone with bots off and unlimited Max Score.
Push the ball into the goal six times without ending the match.

achievements.description: Collect 5 cars
achievements.summary: Collect 5 cars.

steps.text: Finish the New Driver challenges and keep earning item drops until five cars are collected.

achievements.description: Collect 50 Items
achievements.summary: Collect 50 items.

steps.text: Keep finishing games and open drops until 50 items are collected. See Stocked for sources.

achievements.description: Complete the regular Season
achievements.summary: Complete the regular Season.

guide.context: The shortest season is nine matches.

steps.text: Start a season: 1v1, Rookie difficulty, 9 weeks, 4 playoff teams.
Play all nine regular-season matches.

achievements.description: Customize the Decal, Topper, Rocket Boost and Wheel on a car
achievements.summary: Customize the Decal, Topper, Rocket Boost and Wheel on a single car.

steps.text: Open the Garage and pick one car.
Equip a new Decal, Topper, Rocket Boost and Wheel on that car.

achievements.description: Play a total of 20 games across any game mode
achievements.summary: Play 20 games in any mode.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Finish 20 matches. Wins are not required.

achievements.description: Make 20 Saves
achievements.summary: Make 20 saves.

guide.context: With a second controller, the other player can shoot at you instead.

steps.text: Start a private match against a Rookie bot with Ball Weight set to Heavy and unlimited Max Score.
Stand near your goal and block the bot's first shot, then restart the match. Repeat until 20 saves.

achievements.description: Score a goal by hitting your opponent into the ball
achievements.summary: Score a goal by hitting an opponent into the ball.

steps.text: Start a match with a second player: split-screen or a private match with a friend.
Have the second player drive between you and the ball.
Ram their car so it knocks the ball into the goal.

achievements.description: Use your Rocket Boost for a total of 5 minutes
achievements.summary: Use Rocket Boost for 5 minutes in total.

steps.text: Boost for 5 minutes across any matches. The wall-driving method for Far, Far Away covers this too.

achievements.description: Complete every Practice Drill (any difficulty)
achievements.summary: Complete every Practice Drill.

steps.text: Open Play > Training and finish Striker, Goalie and Aerial.
Only finishing counts. Succeeding is not needed.

achievements.description: With only 60 seconds left, Win a game in which you were tied or trailing
achievements.summary: Win a game after being tied or behind with 60 seconds left.

guide.context: Breaking a 0-0 tie may not count, so make sure the other side has scored.

steps.text: Start a private match with a second player.
Have the second player score one goal early.
When One Minute Remaining shows, score two goals yourself to win.

achievements.description: Completely fill and then empty your Rocket Boost 10 times in a single match
achievements.summary: Fill your Rocket Boost to full and empty it 10 times in a single match.

steps.text: Start a match with no bots and a long timer.
Collect a large boost pad to fill the meter to full.
Hold boost until it is empty, then collect another. Repeat ten times.

achievements.description: Collect 5 Items
achievements.summary: Collect 5 items.

steps.text: Finish games until five items are collected.

achievements.description: Drive on the dome walls for a total of 5 minutes
achievements.summary: Drive on the dome walls for 5 minutes in total.

steps.text: Drive up the wall in Freeplay or an Exhibition with bots off.
Keep driving on the wall until 5 minutes add up.

achievements.description: Play against every team in a Season
achievements.summary: Face every opposing team during one Season.

guide.context: If this does not unlock, finish one more match or relaunch the game.

steps.text: Start a season: 1v1, Rookie, 9 weeks, 4 playoff teams.
Finish all nine regular-season matches. Each is against a different team.

achievements.description: Play one game each with Octane and Backfire
achievements.summary: Play one game each with Octane and Backfire.

guide.context: If this does not unlock, finish one more match or relaunch the game.

steps.text: Unlock Backfire through the New Driver challenges.
Open a private match with bots off and a one-goal limit. Drive Octane and win.
Equip Backfire and win another match.

achievements.description: Watch a save file in Replay mode
achievements.summary: Watch a saved replay.

steps.text: After a match, choose Save Replay.
From the main menu, open Extras > Replays and play the replay.

achievements.description: Win a total of 5 games across any mode
achievements.summary: Win 5 games in any mode.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Win five matches.

achievements.description: Win a game without giving up a single Goal
achievements.summary: Win a game without conceding a goal.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Score the goal and win.

achievements.description: Win a 3v3 game
achievements.summary: Win a 3v3 game.

steps.text: Start an Exhibition match set to 3v3 with no bots and Max Score 1.
Score once and win.

achievements.description: Win a 2v2 game
achievements.summary: Win a 2v2 game.

steps.text: Start an Exhibition match set to 2v2 with no bots and Max Score 1.
Score once and win.

achievements.description: Win a 1v1 game
achievements.summary: Win a 1v1 game.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.

achievements.description: Win your first game of the Season
achievements.summary: Win your first game of a Season.

guide.context: A loss in the first match cannot be undone. Start a new season to try again.

steps.text: Start a season: 1v1, Rookie, 9 weeks, 4 playoff teams.
Win the first match. If you lose, start a new season.

achievements.description: Score a goal while reversing
achievements.summary: Score with your car moving backward when it hits the ball.

steps.text: Right after kickoff, spin the car around and back into the ball so it rolls into the net.

achievements.description: Complete a Practice Drill
achievements.summary: Complete a Practice Drill.

steps.text: Open Play > Training and finish any drill.

achievements.description: Play a game in six different Arenas
achievements.summary: Finish matches in six separate arenas.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Choose a new arena for each match. Six that count: Beckwith Park, DFH Stadium, Mannfield, Urban Central, Utopia Coliseum and Wasteland. Weather versions of an arena are not extra arenas.

achievements.description: Customize one slot on a car
achievements.summary: Customize one slot on a car.

steps.text: Open the Garage and change any slot except the body.

achievements.description: Score your first Goal
achievements.summary: Score your first goal.

steps.text: Hit the ball into the opponent goal in any match.

achievements.description: Play an Online game with someone in your Party
achievements.summary: Play an online game with a player who is in your party.

guide.context: If it does not unlock, both players restart the game and try again.

steps.text: Invite a friend into your party.
Start an online match together and finish it.

achievements.description: Play an Exhibition match
achievements.summary: Play an Exhibition match.

steps.text: Start any Exhibition match and finish it.

achievements.description: Win a Season Championship using Dominus in every game
achievements.summary: Win a Season Championship using Dominus in every game.

guide.context: Do not switch cars during the season.

steps.text: Equip Dominus.
Start a season: 1v1, Rookie, 9 weeks, 4 playoff teams.
Win every game, including both playoff games, with Dominus.

achievements.description: Drive 10 km with the Vortex, Cristiano, or Spinner Wheels
achievements.summary: Drive 10 km with the Vortex, Cristiano or Spinner wheels.

steps.text: Equip one of those wheels in the Garage.
Play matches with them equipped until you have driven 10 km.

achievements.description: Equip Dominus or Takumi with any Decal, then win a game
achievements.summary: Put any Decal on a Dominus or Takumi, then win a match in that car.

guide.context: If the win does not count, retry with a decal that belongs to that car's own pack.

steps.text: In the Garage, equip Dominus or Takumi and put a Decal on it.
Start a match with Max Score 1 and win.

achievements.description: Use the Thermal, Burnout, or Nitrous Rocket Boost for a total of 10 minutes
achievements.summary: Use the Thermal, Burnout or Nitrous boost for 10 minutes in total.

steps.text: Equip one of those boosts in the Garage.
Play matches using boost until 10 minutes add up.

achievements.description: Play a complete game with Dominus or Takumi
achievements.summary: Finish an entire match driving a Dominus or Takumi.

steps.text: Equip Dominus or Takumi.
Play a full match to the end. Max Score 1 vs a bot is quick.

achievements.description: Perform a 180 powerslide with Dominus or Takumi
achievements.summary: Perform a 180-degree powerslide with Dominus or Takumi.

guide.context: If the slide does not count, try again with the Cristiano or Spinner wheels equipped.

steps.text: Equip Dominus or Takumi.
Drive, hold the powerslide button and turn the car around 180 degrees.

achievements.description: Score an Aerial Goal
achievements.summary: Score an aerial goal.

guide.context: The ball must be above the crossbar when you hit it in the air.

steps.text: Jump and boost to hit the ball while it is above the top of the goal.
Hit it into the net. Low gravity makes this easier in a private match.

achievements.description: Win a 4v4 game
achievements.summary: Win a 4v4 game.

steps.text: Start an Exhibition match set to 4v4 with no bots and Max Score 1.
Score once and win.

achievements.description: Play a game on Utopia Coliseum
achievements.summary: Play a game on Utopia Coliseum.

steps.text: Start a match, choose the Utopia Coliseum arena, and finish it. Winning is not required.

achievements.description: Equip a Topper and win an Unfair Bot Match
achievements.summary: Wear any Topper and beat Unfair-level bots in a match.

steps.text: Equip the Shark Fin topper.
Start a private match: you versus two Unfair bots, Max Score 1, Boost Amount Unlimited, Boost Strength 10x.
Score one goal to win.

achievements.description: Win a game against All-Star Bots with a Decal equipped
achievements.summary: Beat All-Star-level bots while your car has a Decal on.

steps.text: Equip the Hearts decal on your car.
Start a private match against an All-Star bot with Max Score 1 and win.

achievements.description: Win an Online Match with Backfire, Scarab, or Zippy
achievements.summary: Take an online victory while driving Backfire, Scarab or Zippy.

guide.context: Larger team sizes make a win easier. Ranked is not required.

steps.text: Equip Backfire, Scarab or Zippy.
Play online matches until your team wins one.

achievements.description: Use the Standard or Accelerato Boost with Octane or Backfire while playing in Urban Central
achievements.summary: Use the Standard or Accelerato boost with Octane or Backfire in Urban Central.

guide.context: If Urban Central does not count, repeat the match on Utopia Coliseum.

steps.text: Equip Octane or Backfire with the Standard or Accelerato boost.
Start a private match on Urban Central and use boost.

achievements.description: Win the MVP award using Backfire, Scarab, or Zippy
achievements.summary: Finish a match as MVP while driving Backfire, Scarab or Zippy.

steps.text: Equip Backfire, Scarab or Zippy.
Play a 2v2 or 3v3 against Rookie bots and finish with the highest score.

achievements.description: Equip the Flamethrower Boost and win a 4v4 Online match
achievements.summary: Use the Flamethrower boost in a 4v4 online match that your team wins.

steps.text: Equip the Flamethrower boost.
Win a 4v4 online match, or a private 4v4 with Max Score 1.

achievements.description: With Merc or Grog, Score 10 Goals against Pro-Level Bots or higher
achievements.summary: Score 10 goals against Pro bots or harder with Merc or Grog.

steps.text: Equip Merc or Grog.
Start a private 1v1 against a Pro bot with unlimited time and Max Score.
Score 10 goals.

achievements.description: With Ripper, Score 10 Goals against Pro-level Bots or higher
achievements.summary: Score 10 goals against Pro bots or harder with Ripper.

steps.text: Equip Ripper.
Start a private 1v1 against a Pro bot with unlimited time and Max Score.
Score 10 goals.

achievements.description: Make 50 total Shots on Goal using Merc, Grog, or Ripper
achievements.summary: Make 50 Shots on Goal with Merc, Grog or Ripper in total.

guide.context: Shots with the three cars add together.

steps.text: Equip Merc, Grog or Ripper.
Play with no bots and unlimited time and Max Score. Shoot at the goal until 50 shots show.

achievements.description: Demolish 3 opposing bots in Wasteland
achievements.summary: Demolish 3 opposing bots in Wasteland in one match.

steps.text: Start a match on Wasteland against bots with the Demolish mutator set to On Contact.
Touch three opposing bots in the same match.

achievements.description: Play a complete match in 3 different Rocket Labs Arenas
achievements.summary: Finish full matches in three separate Rocket Labs arenas.

steps.text: Start a private match with the Rocket Labs Medley arena and Max Score 1.
Finish matches until three different arenas have been played, such as Utopia Retro, Cosmic and Pillars.

achievements.description: In Snow Day, score a goal from your own side of the ice
achievements.summary: In Snow Day, score a goal from your own side of the ice.

steps.text: Open a private Snow Day game with one player per side, bots off, and a one-goal win limit.
Push the puck to your half, turn around and hit it hard into the opposing goal.

achievements.description: Win a Snow Day match with both the Blue and Orange teams
achievements.summary: Win a Snow Day match as both the Blue and Orange teams.

steps.text: Open a private Snow Day game with one player per side, bots off, and a one-goal win limit.
Win once as Blue, then switch teams and win as Orange.

achievements.description: Score at least 2 Dunks in the first minute of a Hoops game
achievements.summary: Dunk twice or more during the opening 60 seconds of a Hoops match.

steps.text: Start a private Hoops match, 1v1.
Drive straight at the ball at kickoff with a short boost. Dunk twice in the first minute.

achievements.description: With 30 seconds left, win a game of Hoops in which you were tied or trailing
achievements.summary: Win a Hoops game after being tied or behind with 30 seconds left.

steps.text: Start a private Hoops match with a second player or switch teams during play.
Make the score level or trail until 30 seconds remain, then score to win.

achievements.description: Collect a Painted Item
achievements.summary: Collect a painted item.

guide.context: This depends on luck.

steps.text: Play matches and open drops until one painted item drops. Online matches and tournament drops can give them.

achievements.description: Increase the level of a Certified Item
achievements.summary: Raise a Certified item by one level.

guide.context: Each certified item tracks one stat, such as goals or saves.

steps.text: Get a Certified item and equip it.
Play online matches and do the action it counts until its level rises.

achievements.description: Earn Veteran status for your Certified Item
achievements.summary: Earn Veteran status on a Certified item.

steps.text: Keep playing online matches with the Certified item equipped.
Reach Veteran. It takes about 50 wins, 100 goals or saves, or 200 shots on goal, depending on the item.

achievements.description: Win the MVP award in a game that goes to overtime
achievements.summary: Finish as MVP in a match that ends in overtime.

steps.text: Start a match against a bot and keep the score level.
In overtime, stay the top scorer on your team until the match ends.

achievements.description: Score a Goal, Save a shot, and Assist a teammate in a single game
achievements.summary: Within one match, get a goal, a save and an assist.

steps.text: Play a 2v2 with a second player.
In one match, score a goal, make a save and set up a teammate's goal.

achievements.description: Activate every power-up in Rumble mode
achievements.summary: Activate every power-up in Rumble.

guide.context: A power-up arrives about every 10 seconds, and you can hold one for later.

steps.text: Start a Rumble match against a bot.
Fire off each power-up as it arrives until all 11 have been used. The list is Tornado, Swapper, Spike, Power Hitter, Plunger, Magnetizer, Haymaker, Grappling Hook, Freezer, Disruptor and Boot.

achievements.description: In Rumble, freeze an opponent's shot before it can score
achievements.summary: In Rumble, freeze an opponent shot before it can score.

steps.text: Play Rumble against a bot until you get the Freezer.
Wait near your goal and use it on the bot's shot toward your goal.

achievements.description: Head to AquaDome and score a goal while flipped on your back
achievements.summary: Score a goal in AquaDome while flipped on your back.

steps.text: Start a private match on AquaDome.
Jump and flip onto your back, then hit the ball into the goal while upside down.

achievements.description: Score an Aerial goal while playing in AquaDome
achievements.summary: Score an aerial goal in AquaDome.

steps.text: Start a private match on AquaDome.
Hit the ball in the air and score an aerial goal.

achievements.description: Make 535 Shots on Goal
achievements.summary: Make 535 Shots on Goal.

steps.text: Open a private match with bots off, no time limit, no score limit, and Disable Goal Reset on.
Shoot at the goal until 535 shots are counted.

achievements.description: Head to 'Arena Preferences' and use all of your votes
achievements.summary: Use all your votes in Arena Preferences.

steps.text: Open Play > Casual > Arenas.
Like the maximum number of maps and dislike the maximum number.

achievements.description: Equip the Ion Rocket Boost or the Halo Topper and win a match on Starbase ARC
achievements.summary: Win a match on Starbase ARC wearing the Ion boost or the Halo topper.

guide.context: Only some versions count: Sport Halo, Legacy Halo, Special Ion, Legacy Ion and Import Ion. Other Halo topper variants do not.

steps.text: Get an Ion boost or Halo topper. They come from drops.
Equip one and win a private match on Starbase ARC with Max Score 1.

achievements.description: Complete a match on wasted land, under the sea, and in outer space
achievements.summary: Complete a match on Wasteland, AquaDome and Starbase ARC.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Exhibition} match: 1v1, no bots, and in Mutator Settings set Max Score to 1 goal.
Play one match on each of those three arenas.

achievements.description: Win a Dropshot match via shutout
achievements.summary: Win a Dropshot match without letting the opponent score.

steps.text: Open a private Dropshot game with one player per side, bots off, and a one-goal win limit.
Break a floor panel and score before the other side does.

achievements.description: Score a total of 18 Goals in Dropshot
achievements.summary: Across Dropshot games, reach 18 goals.

steps.text: Open a private Dropshot game with one player per side, bots off, and no time or score limit.
Bounce the ball hard to open floor panels and score. Repeat to 18 goals.

achievements.description: Damage a total of 320 panels in Dropshot
achievements.summary: Break or crack 320 floor panels over your Dropshot games.

steps.text: Play Dropshot with unlimited time and score. Hit the ball hard to damage panels until 320 are counted.

achievements.description: Equip a Deluxe Item and complete a game in an Arena with turbulent weather
achievements.summary: Wear a Deluxe item and finish a match on a stormy arena.

steps.text: Get a Deluxe item and equip it.
Start a private match on an arena marked Stormy and finish it.

achievements.description: Head to Champions Field and complete an Online game
achievements.summary: Complete an online game on Champions Field.

steps.text: Play online matches until Champions Field loads, then finish that match.

achievements.description: Change your Player Banner, Avatar Border, and Player Title
achievements.summary: Change your Player Banner, Avatar Border and Player Title.

steps.text: Make sure you own a banner, a border and a title.
Open your Profile and change all three.

achievements.description: Trade In five items of the same quality to receive an item of the next-highest quality
achievements.summary: Turn five same-quality items into one item of the next quality up.

steps.text: Open Garage > Manage Inventory and pick five items of the same quality.
Confirm the trade-up.

achievements.description: Complete all placement matches in any Competitive Playlist
achievements.summary: Finish the full set of placement games in one Competitive playlist.

steps.text: Reach level 20 to unlock ranked play.
Play all 10 placement matches in one competitive playlist.

achievements.description: Score or Assist a combined 30 goals or assists in Casual or Competitive Online matches
achievements.summary: Score or assist 30 goals and assists in total in online Casual or Competitive matches.

steps.text: Play online Casual or Competitive matches until your goals and assists reach 30.

achievements.description: Create or Join a Rocket League Club
achievements.summary: Found a club or become a member of one.

steps.text: Open Profile > Create Club, or accept a club invite.

achievements.description: Play and complete an Online match with one or more Clubmates
achievements.summary: Finish one online game alongside a member of your club.

steps.text: Join a club with another player.
Queue and finish an online match together.

achievements.description: Join and complete an Online Tournament match
achievements.summary: Join and complete an online Tournament match.

steps.text: Play a public tournament, or make a custom 2v2 tournament with three friends (Best of 1 finals, name and password join, Max Score 1).
Finish a tournament match.

achievements.description: Play and complete 10 Online matches with one or more Clubmates
achievements.summary: Finish ten online games alongside a member of your club.

steps.text: Queue with a clubmate and finish 10 online matches together.

achievements.description: Score a Goal while in a Club Match (Online Matchmaking only)
achievements.summary: Score a goal in a club match in online matchmaking.

steps.text: Play online matchmaking until you land in a club match, using a clubmate or a second club account.
Score a goal in that club match.

achievements.description: Earn the MVP award in any Online Tournament match
achievements.summary: Earn the MVP award in an online tournament match.

steps.text: Play a public tournament or a custom 2v2 tournament.
Finish a match with the highest score on your team.
